en.title: localhost Inside a Container Isn't Your Machine: Docker Networking Explained
en.subtitle: Each container has its own localhost. Other containers are reached by name and container port, your machine through host.docker.internal.

ar-EG.title: ليه الـ localhost جوه الـ container مش جهازك؟ شرح الـ networking في Docker
ar-EG.subtitle: كل container ليه localhost خاص بيه. والـ containers التانية بتوصلها بالاسم والـ port بتاع الـ container، وجهازك بتوصله بـ host.docker.internal.
